results.remarks: Welcome to 53664 Via Strada, a completely remodeled estate in the prestigious Hideaway community of La Quinta. Set against sweeping golf course and mountain views, this single-level residence blends timeless Spanish Colonial architecture with fresh, modern finishes throughout. A gated courtyard entry creates a gracious arrival, leading into expansive living spaces designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling sliding doors open to the covered loggia, pool, spa, and view-facing outdoor areas, creating a striking backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. The newly remodeled interior features a refined neutral palette, updated surfaces, designer fixtures, and a bright, open flow. The kitchen has been reimagined with generous workspace, an oversized island, updated cabinetry, and premium finishes. Spacious living and dining areas connect effortlessly to the outdoors, maximizing the home’s panoramic setting. The floor plan includes 4 bedroom suites, 3 of the rooms open onto the courtyard, including a separate private casita complete with kitchenette. The primary suite is a spacious retreat with direct outdoor access, a beautifully updated bathroom, and a cozy fireplace for ambience. The primary bathroom is a luxurious experience- enjoy soaking in the freestanding tub, or step into the oversized statement shower with bench seating, natural lighting, and dual shower heads. Additional amenities of the home include a game room located just past the kitchen, a large laundry room with natural light and lots of storage, and a fully remodeled powder room for guests. Outdoors, multiple entertaining spaces include dining, lounging, a gorgeous fireplace with outdoor tv. The pool includes a tanning ledge, water features, and of course, the attached spa which is perfect for cooler evenings. The indoor outdoor lifestyle is all punctuated by the picturesque unobstructed views across the fairway of the Pete Dye course, and surrounding desert mountains. Hideaway offers a lifestyle that extends well beyond the residence itself, representing one of the desert’s premier private club communities. Known for its elevated club and golf experience, Hideaway is widely regarded among the deserts top-tier private clubs. Membership is available, sold separately from the property, and subject to club approval.

results.remarks: Welcome to this exceptional Rancho La Quinta C.C. home. Ideally situated on a desirable corner lot with no neighbor on one side and adjacent to a lush greenbelt. A private courtyard entry welcomes you into a beautifully appointed home offering an outstanding combination of indoor comfort and resort-style outdoor living.Professionally landscaped grounds create a private oasis featuring a sparkling pool with elevated spa and cascading waterfall. Large entertainer's patio with a custom Alumawood gazebo. An additional south-side patio includes a built-in BBQ, putting green and mature citrus trees. The interior features neutral tile flooring, neutral-tone walls and large landscape windows showcase the surrounding landscape. The living area is enhanced by a beautiful fireplace with custom mantle and hearth, complemented by custom built-in cabinetry. The primary bedroom features French doors that open to the pool and spa and feature a vanishing screen. There are custom built-ins in the primary closet and rich Acacia wood flooring. The second bedroom also features Acacia flooring. Custom window coverings including shades and shutters. Handsome raised-panel interior doors and designer lighting fixtures add a refined finishing touch. A Nest air-conditioning system provides convenient climate control. The remodeled kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertainment, featuring slab granite countertops, custom backsplash, a large center island, stainless-steel appliances and climate-controlled wine storage. Numerous improvements have been completed within the past five years, including resurfacing of the main patio, the pool and spa refreshed with new pool tile trim, new patio furniture and covers, a new variable-speed pool pump, and an insurance-approved Moen automatic water shut-off system. The fire alarm is configured to report directly to the local fire station. Additional updates include interior paint and new baseboards, pendant lighting over the kitchen island, a new Bosch dishwasher, ceiling fans in two guest rooms, a new dining room light fixture, all-new mattress sets and new living room furniture. Furnished per Inventory List. The three-car garage features epoxy flooring and extensive built-in storage, including convenient overhead racks. A solar power system adds energy efficiency to this beautiful home. Buyer to assume lease payments and terms. Approx. $271 per month. Documented $0 energy bill from IID.

results.remarks: Welcome to the Signature Homes, located in PGA West! This guard gated subdivision offers resort living all within its own private community. This modern luxury condominium, just under 2,000 square feet and built in 2023, feels like a single-family home. The turnkey residence features 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, beautifully furnished and designed by Slim Keskes of Atelier Slim Keskes. The contemporary decor combines neutral tones with vibrant local colors, creating a stylish yet functional space. The main floor includes an open-plan great room, an ''entertainer's kitchen'' with upgraded appliances and a massive island, and a spacious primary suite with upgraded vanities. Residents of Signature Homes are allowed to obtain a Short Term Rental Permit from the City of La Quinta if they are looking for an investment opportunity. Within the Signature gates, homeowners have access to the community's pool & spa, BBQ area, fitness center, & recreation room, all included in the HOA dues. Don't miss out on making this exceptional property yours!

results.remarks: Live a life of luxury in this stunning 2,170 square foot Oreas model home within the gates of the premier 55+ Trilogy at La Quinta and Golf Resort. A new Thermador 36'' six-burner cooktop with matching hood/vent and a Bosch  double oven make quick work of your favorite recipes. A door to the outside covered patio and kitchen dining area and separate formal dining room make entertaining a breeze.

results.remarks: Absolutely one of the best views in this Trilogy La Quinta 55+ gated community! This is a VERY rare and unique property! It is the ONLY 4 bedroom most desired Monterey floor plan that includes a newly built (2023) custom detached guest house casita that is legally permitted as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU). It makes a great granny/caregiver flat or it can be rented for 30+ days for $1,200 to $2,800 a month depending on the season. The main house has spectacular unblockable views from the foyer, great room, kitchen, and master. Main house has 3 of the 4 bedrooms, 2 baths and has been completely remodeled from top to bottom with high-end finishes including a newly renovated master bedroom and ensuite bath as of October 2025. Upgrades include a new Lennox AC, new windows throughout, new lighting, black-out curtains in the master and great room, large electric awning, plantation shutters, roller shades, crown molding in all rooms, luxury vinyl plank flooring, wood laminate and porcelain tile in every room. The newly remodeled kitchen has high end ''Champaign'' finished cabinetry including roll outs, soft close drawers and doors, glass backsplash, granite counters, upper cabinet rope lighting, under-cabinet lighting, and a custom pantry door with LED remote controlled back-lighting. There are 10 new designer ceiling fans throughout, including the kitchen, baths, patio, and garage. The great room has a newly remodeled fireplace and mantel with under-mantel rope lighting. The courtyard that separates the house from the casita has a contemporary water feature and a new concrete overlay deck. The detached casita includes both a 60'' and 50' flat panel TV, a full galley style kitchen (except dishwasher) with all Whirlpool stainless steel appliances including a 5 burner gas range with double ovens, a built-in microwave, 2 door refrigerator with ice maker, and a stainless steel sink. The casita has quartz countertops in the kitchen, bath and laundry room, and high-end porcelain plank distressed flooring and carpeting. The bath boasts a large walk-in shower with multiple shower heads with a digital timer and temperature readout. The back yard is spacious enough for a large pool/spa. (See virtual photos) The garage includes epoxy floors, high-end New Age 8 gauge steel cabinets, 2 work benches with stainless steel tops, overhead storage racks and a large wall organizer.  Buyer to pay the 1 time HOA Reserve Assessment Fee of $3,732. Owner is also the listing broker.

Enjoy panoramic 180-degree lake, golf course, and Santa Rosa Mountain views from this ideally positioned home overlooking the 10th fairway of the Pete Dye Dunes Course. Duna La Quinta is a gated enclave, in close proximity to the legendary La Quinta Resort. Residents enjoy easy access to world-class golf, tennis, pickleball, dining, shopping, hiking, Old Town La Quinta, and the area's renowned music and art festivals. Properties with this combination of views, floor plan, two locked off rooms, and ''close-to-everything'' location rarely come available at this price. 100% livable today while bringing your vision to make this exceptional property your very own. results.remarks: Sunshine, Fairways and Mountain Views. Located in the heart of the 55+ Trilogy Golf Club at La Quinta, this delightful golf course retreat makes the most of its sunny and expansive east and southwest golf course and mountain views. The open concept, high ceilings, and big picture windows open to a large back patio, making the 1,745 SQFT home feel much larger. And, with two bedrooms, two-full baths, a den/office, and a bonus room, the home easily adapts to all your lifestyle needs. On warm sunny days, the slate-colored tile flooring, a pergola and automated sunshades on the patio keep outdoor living cool and comfortable. On cool winter days, the family room fireplace is the perfect place to snuggle up with a good book or to binge-watch your favorite TV shows. Anytime is the best time to watch the sun rise above the horizon, golfers as they try to top their best scores, and the moon as it glides across the mountain peaks. Inside, the home is upgraded with attractive and durable wide-plank luxury vinyl floors that blend seamlessly with the custom stone floors in the bedrooms. The kitchen is open to the dining area with windows overlooking the backyard patio and big golf course views. Beautiful and efficient, the kitchen is well-organized for cooking and entertaining. Abundant quality antique white cabinets and a pantry keep the kitchen tidy. The counters and the center island are crowned with dreamy quartz and are complemented by a glass subway tiled backsplash. A double oven, gas cooktop, new stainless microwave and refrigerator make quick work of meal prep. The primary bedroom is roomy with plantation shutters, and a large walk-in closet. The primary bath features dual vanities with custom antique white cabinets, and a custom walk-in steam shower and tile surround with a bench seat. A guest bedroom and a den with a nearby full bath are separated from the primary bedroom. A bonus is a separate covered patio with etched glass walls, open to the main living area, and with sliding doors that open to a private patio at the side of the home. The garage fits two cars side-by-side with room for storage and is air conditioned. Priced to sell this home will not last long. Make this beauty yours!

results.remarks: Set within La Quinta Cove, this newly constructed modern residence by award-winning GHA Companies offers a refined yet livable approach to desert architecture. The design is clean and contemporary, shaped by light, proportion, and an easy sense of flow that feels natural rather than forced. From the entry, the home opens into a bright, expansive great room where living, dining, and kitchen spaces connect as one continuous environment. Tall ceilings and an open layout with integrated speakers throughout create a sense of volume and calm, allowing the home to breathe. The kitchen anchors the space with quartz countertops, a generous modern island, Bosch appliances, walk-in pantry, and curated finishes that feel intentional without being overdesigned.  Large sliding glass doors extend the interior to a covered patio and a low-maintenance, drought-conscious landscape, creating a natural transition between indoor and outdoor living. The home is designed to move easily with the rhythm of the desert, open in the morning, relaxed in the evening, and effortless in between. The primary suite is positioned as a quiet retreat with direct patio access and a spa-style bath featuring dual vanities, clerestory windows, a walk-in shower, separate soaking tub, and a custom walk-in closet. Two junior ensuites, each with their own private bath, offer flexible space for guests, family, or work-from-home use, along with a separate guest bath. Additional features include owned and paid-for solar, keyless entry, integrated security system, a dedicated laundry room with utility sink, attached two-car garage, west-facing facade, and no monthly HOA fees. Located just minutes from Old Town La Quinta and moments from world-class dining, golf, shopping, resorts, and entertainment, this home offers a modern desert lifestyle defined by design, comfort, and long-term livability.
